profileEvidence.author: A
profileEvidence.summary: Affectionate, sociable Portuguese Pointers and steady, determined Old Danish Pointers show the range of character within the Braque family. These continental pointing breeds work with hunters to locate game. The Portuguese breed once helped falconers by indicating quarry before a hawk was released; today it remains persistent and closely attentive to its handler.
profileEvidence.shortDescription: A continental pointing family with distinct temperaments, from the affectionate Portuguese Pointer to the steady Old Danish.
